prs.title: fix: allow integer file descriptors for errlog in stdio_client
prs.author: RudrenduPaul
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: stdio_client's errlog parameter cannot accept non-TextIO stderr targets. In Jupyter, sys.stderr is an IPython-wrapped object that subprocess rejects; the fix in both PRs is to allow integer file descriptors (e.g. subprocess.DEVNULL) as a valid errlog value. PR #2020 adds automatic Jupyter detection to route around the limitation; PR #2410 widens the type signature to TextIO | int so callers (or that detection code) can pass an integer FD explicitly. Both are responses to the same root constraint in _create_platform_compatible_process. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2410 is the minimal, general fix: it changes the type annotation to TextIO | int in two places and adds docstring clarification, with no runtime heuristics. PR #2020 adds ~30 lines of IPython introspection logic that can silently misfire on non-notebook IPython shells (the ZMQInteractiveShell check) and requires an IPython import. #2410's approach lets callers opt in explicitly (pass subprocess.DEVNULL) without hidden auto-detection, and its smaller diff reduces merge-conflict surface with the other open PRs on this file.

members.title: feat: support stderr logging in Jupyter notebook environments
members.author: BabyChrist666
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2410: stdio_client's errlog parameter cannot accept non-TextIO stderr targets. In Jupyter, sys.stderr is an IPython-wrapped object that subprocess rejects; the fix in both PRs is to allow integer file descriptors (e.g. subprocess.DEVNULL) as a valid errlog value. PR #2020 adds automatic Jupyter detection to route around the limitation; PR #2410 widens the type signature to TextIO | int so callers (or that detection code) can pass an integer FD explicitly. Both are responses to the same root constraint in _create_platform_compatible_process.
